description: Best times to post for one account on any network (YouTube included), ranked from its own history. Returns suggestions plus `basis` (METRICS = engagement numbers, PUBLISH_HISTORY = frequency only); an account with no posts returns an empty list with reason NO_HISTORY. GOOGLE BUSINESS PROFILE has no engagement data to rank by: it returns empty suggestions with reason NOT_SUPPORTED (not an error). Requires the SCHEDULE_READ scope (key issued by the workspace owner).

channel.description: Network of the account, e.g. INSTAGRAM (UPPERCASE canonical, lowercase accepted).

name: get_best_times
title: Get best times to post
